evidence_reviews.reason: Two media requests still required correction. The first had two stalled embeds and a certificate-date error. The second reached protected playback before two archived programs were disqualified. The edition recovered and published.

The raw audit recorded 34 inspected entries and 76 unreviewed for 109 eligible sources. It included qualification-only Zapier in the inspection entries. The audited breadth is unknown. Five distinct article publishers were recorded and zero articles had verified 24-hour timestamps.

The reviewed closeout identified the live release and 24 visual checks as complete. It separately displayed partial research evidence and unproven autonomy. The original Top 10 snapshot retains its production-stage claims.
The November 6–12 series included seven image-attempt observations and a median of 12. The chart marked missing coverage and selection observations as gaps and disclosed the registry change.

The November 12 failure chart counted zero failed workflow jobs while the candidate evidence showed a blocked probe and an archive rejection. The recurring-failure table still contains unclassified events. Preserve the original outcomes so these types remain visible.

Compiler milestones preserve detection and subsequent state changes. The reconciled report has zero recovery incidents with all required clocks and exact references. Separate repair and verification intervals and unattended origin remain unproven.

The November 12 index audit failed to reconcile by eligible ID. The current cycle could not update certified inspection coverage from that partition. Review the actual source scopes and clocks with the enabled roster before selection.

Five published items had validated topic mappings. The rolling contribution table had no validated substantive candidate review rows attributed to registry IDs. The relative contribution of individual sources remains unknown.
